# Reed Creative Labs

> Reed Creative Labs is a veteran-founded, family-built independent software and engineering studio in South Carolina. The studio builds unusual software and interactive systems, premium websites, and focused custom software. Forgefield is its primary product and current release focus.

Forgefield is in release preparation, not publicly available. No release date has been announced. Archived projects are retained as R&D or historical work, not upcoming releases or active commercial commitments. Smaller mobile projects remain secondary; their pages describe development, not availability.

The public website is a static Next.js App Router application built with React and TypeScript. Its signature black-hole visualization uses a modern Fortran state system compiled to WebAssembly, with browser lifecycle and rendering. Product media consists of native captures, not generated promotional art.

## Primary Product

- [Forgefield](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/forgefield): RCL's primary Windows application for procedural live wallpapers and screensavers, with nine native-rendered worlds. Launching Soon; not yet released.

## Selected R&D

- [Phase Arcade Volume I](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/phase-arcade-volume-1): Archived desktop and VR collection with Phase Shift, Phase Breaker, and Phase Court. A record of gameplay and interaction work, not a pending release.
- [Project Load Bearing](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/project-load-bearing): Archived structural construction-and-testing prototype connecting Unreal Engine to a native Fortran static frame solver. Technical R&D, not certified engineering software.
- [Static Drift](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/static-drift): Archived procedural ambient Android TV prototype with native rendering and remote controls. Not an upcoming store release.

## More from RCL

- [Products and Selected R&D](https://reedcreativelabs.com/products): Forgefield, secondary mobile projects, selected archived prototypes, and historical project records.

## Services

- [Studio Services](https://reedcreativelabs.com/services): Premium websites and focused custom software for small businesses, organizations, professionals, and independent creators.
